mappings.rationale: Explicitly labelled ABN column. Training: 3851/3886 nonempty pass ABN checksum, 0 pass ACN checksum. Held-out: 1602/1615 valid; 13 failures are invalid ABN checksums on source values, which the abn transform correctly rejects. Mapping is correct; the invalid values are source data-quality issues and are rejected, not coerced.

Explicitly labelled ACN column. Training: 1658/1667 pass ACN checksum, 0 pass ABN checksum. Held-out: 700/702 valid; 2 failures are invalid ACN checksums, rejected by the acn transform. ACN is not derived from ABN suffix.

Labelled business address, single string per row. Held-out 3000/3000 emitted. Maps to address.full only; locality, state and postcode are embedded and not separated here. Address is a licensee business address and may relate to an individual, so it is not confirmed as a registered address.
